findings.title: PPO model exclusively outputs SHORT action
findings.claim: action_probabilities[1] (LONG) is near 0 for all sampled predictions. 645/645 executed trades are SHORT.
findings.raw_evidence: redis-cli get v2:prediction:LITUSDT:15m => action_probabilities=[2.42e-7, 1.40e-7, 0.9999996]; 645/645 closed trades action='short'

findings.title: Trailing stop is dominant loss driver (89.9% loss rate)
findings.claim: 395 TS exits (61.2%), WR=10.1%, total_pnl=-$135.97. TS fires prematurely due to tight stop distance.
findings.raw_evidence: Computed from 645 closed trades: ts_count=395, ts_wins=40, ts_losses=355

findings.title: Portfolio equity does not include $22.23 realized PnL from closed trades
findings.claim: v2:portfolio:state.realized_pnl_usd=0.0 despite $22.23 net realized from 645 closed trades

findings.title: squeeze_evidence_score null on 100% of trades
findings.claim: No squeeze detection active. High-volume reversals, liquidation cascades enter without filter.

findings.title: bid_ask_spread_bps constant at 2.0 bps — not market-observed
findings.claim: Spread constant means low-liquidity symbols (NIGHTUSDT, PUMPUSDT) receive same treatment as BTC. Router's 12-bps threshold never triggers.

findings.title: drawdown_at_entry always 0.0 — drawdown risk guard non-functional
findings.claim: Drawdown guard code exists in strategy router but is unreachable because the tracker never reports non-zero drawdown.
findings.raw_evidence: 645/645 rows: drawdown_at_entry=0.0; strategy_router/service.py:405-410 thresholds configured but never triggered

findings.title: 5m and 4h timeframes structurally net-negative across 645-trade soak
findings.claim: 5m: -$10.15, 4h: -$3.65. Both negative since soak inception. Not a transient effect.
findings.raw_evidence: Computed from all 645 trades: tf_pnl[5m]=-10.15, tf_pnl[4h]=-3.65

findings.title: Global WR 30.39% is below 35% gate threshold
findings.claim: After 645 trades, WR has not recovered to 35%. WR was 29.56% at 504 trades, now 30.39% — marginal improvement.

findings.title: trend_mode captures 91.5% of trades due to PPO/MASA short-direction alignment
findings.claim: Strategy router assigns trend_mode when higher_direction==action. Since PPO always outputs short and MASA tends to agree, trend_mode fires on almost every trade.

findings.title: Zero-WR symbols still receiving allocations
findings.claim: NIGHTUSDT (0/5, -$5.64), TIAUSDT (0/3, -$2.85), TRUMPUSDT (0/3, -$2.21), PUMPUSDT (0/3, -$2.53) have persistent zero win rates.

findings.title: Slippage is simulated at fees/2 — not market-observed
findings.claim: For all sampled trades: slippage = fees × 0.5 exactly. This is a simulation constant, not real market microstructure data.
findings.raw_evidence: Sample: fees=0.0466, slip=0.0233 → slip/fees=0.500; pattern repeats across 5 samples

findings.title: LONG paper trade path is entirely untested code
findings.claim: Entry gate, trailing stop, profit bank, and close logic for LONG positions have zero coverage in closed trade record.

findings.title: No MFE/MAE stored per trade — counterfactual analysis limited
findings.claim: Optimal trailing stop distance cannot be computed without intra-trade high/low. Cannot determine if wider stop would convert TS-losses to TP-wins.
findings.raw_evidence: No mfe_usd, mae_usd, intra_trade_high, intra_trade_low fields in closed trade records

findings.title: TIER_4_MAX_HOLD_TIME exits are most profitable (avg +$3.47 per trade)
findings.claim: 3 max-hold-time exits average +$3.47 each. Suggests letting positions run longer may benefit some symbols.

findings.title: AEROUSDT, ESPORTSUSDT, BNBUSDT, BSBUSDT are reliable positive performers
findings.claim: Combined: AEROUSDT +$8.55 (39% WR, 18 trades), ESPORTSUSDT +$7.24 (48% WR, 40 trades), BNBUSDT +$7.39 (67% WR, 3 trades), BSBUSDT +$8.04 (41% WR, 22 trades).
